info.name: Clio API Documentation Activities Calendars API
Return the data for all Calendars

params.name: created_since
params.description: Filter Calendar records to those having the `created_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: fields
params.description: The fields to be returned. See response samples for what fields are available. For more information see the [fields section](#section/Fields).

params.name: filter_inactive_users
params.description: Filter any shared UserCalendar records whose owner is inactive.

params.name: ids[]
params.description: Filter Calendar records to those having the specified unique identifiers.

params.name: limit
params.description: A limit on the number of Calendar records to be returned. Limit can range between 1 and 200. Default: `200`.

params.name: order
params.description: Orders the Calendar records by the given field. Default: `id(asc)`.

params.name: owner
params.description: Filter Calendar records to those that the user owns.

params.name: page_token
params.description: A token specifying which page to return.

params.name: source
params.description: Filter Calendar records to those having a specific calendar visibility source (mobile, web).

params.name: type
params.description: Filter Calendar records to those of the specified type.

params.name: updated_since
params.description: Filter Calendar records to those having the `updated_at` field after a specific time. (Expects an ISO-8601 timestamp).

params.name: visible
params.description: Filter Calendar records to those that are visible.

params.name: writeable
params.description: Filter Calendar records to those which the user can write to.
